continuity: The Supreme Peak Quest [An Unknown Death] is complete; Jin received the special Item Eyes of Truth, and the quest confirmed that The Prophet killed Siegfried Wassmann.

Muninn is a succession of identities: Huginn says the current Prophet is the fifth. The first disappeared during the Great Cataclysm; Huginn met the second after the Cataclysm ended and saw the current Prophet once, about three years ago.

Huginn describes the current Prophet as a white man whose face was mostly covered and whose build seemed unsuited to close combat; this is Huginn’s uncertain personal impression, not a confirmed Hunter type.
The Muninn from about three years ago supplied Michael Silbert with information about Cheon Taemin, Leviathan, and Magic Gems, including Leviathan’s presence and the plan to lure it to Tokyo.

Jin believes the Muninns secretly moved unrefined Magic Gems from the Middle East and Africa, stored them, eliminated rivals, and gathered intelligence. He orders the Middle East search teams recalled and calls the leadership team to the strategy room.
Huginn remains captive; Jin leaves him unconscious in the torturers’ custody and orders them to continue questioning him.
plot: Jin completes the Supreme Peak Quest [An Unknown Death] after Huginn confirms that The Prophet killed Siegfried Wassmann, and receives the special Item Eyes of Truth. Pressed for more information, Huginn reveals that Muninn is an identity passed between five people; the current Prophet is the fifth, and Huginn saw him once about three years ago. He describes the man as white, mostly concealed, and seemingly unsuited to close combat, though he admits this is only an impression.

Huginn says the Muninn from three years ago brought Michael Silbert information about Cheon Taemin, Leviathan, and Magic Gems, including Leviathan’s presence and the plan to draw it to Tokyo. Jin concludes that the Muninns served as hidden operatives who gathered intelligence, eliminated rivals, and moved unrefined Magic Gems from the Middle East and Africa. He orders the search teams recalled and the leadership team to the strategy room, then leaves Huginn unconscious in the torturers’ custody for further questioning.
translation_decisions: Treat Muninn as a succession of identities, not as proof that one person has held the role throughout.
Keep Magic Gem distinct from mana and magical power.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is the World Hunter Federation’s Alliance Leader and is pursuing the Main Quest [Cataclysm], which requires him to eliminate The Prophet within an unspecified time limit.
The Supreme Peak Quest [An Unknown Death] is complete; it confirmed The Prophet killed Siegfried Wassmann, and Jin received the special Item Eyes of Truth.

The Prophet is the fifth person to bear the identity Muninn. Huginn saw him once about three years ago and recalls a mostly concealed white man whose build seemed unsuited to close combat; that assessment is uncertain.
The Muninn from about three years ago supplied Michael Silbert with information about Cheon Taemin, Leviathan, and Magic Gems, including the plan to lure Leviathan to Tokyo.

Jin believes the Muninns secretly moved unrefined Magic Gems from the Middle East and Africa, eliminated rivals, and gathered intelligence. He has ordered the search teams recalled and the leadership team to the strategy room.
Huginn remains captive and is unconscious in the torturers’ custody after Jin ordered further questioning.
The Skeleton King and his undead army remain with Xiao Shen after defeating the desert Monster Wave without casualties.
Twenty people were found dead in the desert in the same desiccated condition as Siegfried Wassmann; the cause remains unknown.
open_questions: Who is the current Prophet, and where is he?
How did the Muninns discover Leviathan’s presence in the deep sea?
What caused the deaths of Siegfried Wassmann and the twenty people in the desert?
What disappeared from the desert without leaving a trace, as described by the Skeleton King?
Can Jin find and eliminate The Prophet before the Main Quest’s time limit expires?
temporary_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.
Do not identify the current Prophet or infer the uncertain thought Jin suppresses.
